seo.metaTitle: eIDAS & local document signer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Create a local electronic signature manifest with SHA-256 document digest, signer statement, and UTC timestamp in alignment with EU eIDAS (Regulation 910/2014) and US ESIGN Act principles. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/eidas-sign-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: eIDAS & local document signer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/eidas-sign-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does eIDAS & local document signer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. eIDAS & local document signer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/eidas-sign-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate eIDAS & local document signer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/eidas_sign.json or open /tools/eidas-sign?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
